name: PlantWaterLevel
src_typeComment: A plant's watered-ness as a decaying value, nothing more — no growth-stage/visual behaviour is wired in here on purpose. What a game does with the number (swap a mesh, tint a colour, kill the plant) is left to whatever's listening on OnWaterChanged/OnDried/OnFullyWatered, so this stays usable in a full farming sim or as a one-off decorative interaction.

src_serialized.name: maxWater
src_serialized.tooltip: Upper bound for the water level.

src_serialized.name: startingNormalizedWater
src_serialized.tooltip: Starting water level as a fraction of max (0 = bone dry, 1 = full) when the scene starts.

src_serialized.name: decayPerSecond
src_serialized.tooltip: Water lost per second — plants need repeat watering rather than staying wet forever. 0 = never decays.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<float, float> OnWaterChanged = new UnityEvent<float, float>()
src_members.name: UnityEvent

src_members.sig: public float CurrentWater { get { EnsureInitialized(); return currentWater; } }
src_members.name: EnsureInitialized

src_members.sig: public float NormalizedWater => maxWater <= 0f ? 0f : CurrentWater / maxWater
src_members.name: NormalizedWater
Tick
src_members.comment: Public and separate from Update — same shape as Toolkit.Core.CountdownTimer.Tick — so a self-test can drive decay deterministically instead of waiting on real elapsed time.
